name: @thumbmux/server
description: Server side of the thumbmux mobile terminal stack: multiplexed tmux WebSocket engine with pluggable driver and policy hooks (Bun/Node).

scripts.build: rm -rf dist && bun build src/index.ts src/terminal-replay-worker-entry.ts src/recall-handler.ts src/sqlite-history.ts --outdir dist --target node --external @thumbmux/core && tsc -p tsconfig.build.json && bun run ./scripts/copy-runtime-assets.ts
